technical-summary: libr3's r3_helper_config_exports accepted only a strong (T) export, but rad0012 declares bc_r4d_helper_config weak, so libr3's definition is W and the test failed on every build (including the production lane's libr3.so); it now accepts T or W. libr3 declares its two card-free tests ([test] targets r3_rewrite_check, r3_helper_config_exports, each with a same-named custom target as component-tests requires), so CI runs them.
user-summary-candidate: libr3's kernel-configuration export check now passes and runs in CI.
